newsitem.title: USA: Ameritech buys security monitoring assets.
newsitem.headline: Ameritech buys security monitoring assets.

text.p: Ameritech Corp said Monday it purchased the security monitoring assets of Pre-Alert Security Systems Inc and certain accounts from Intercon Security Ltd.
Terms of the transactions were not disclosed.
SecurityLink from Ameritech Ltd, the company's Canadian security subsidiary, acquired the Pre-Alert assets, including residential and commercial monitoring accounts and equipment.

In a separate agreement, the subsidiary acquired certain residential and commercial monitoring account from Intercon in Vancouver and Toronto. Intercon's Vancouver branch will also provide monitoring services for SecurityLink.
Intercon is a unit of FirstService Corp.
